claim: A pace window's own overhead at 28 MHz is scaled by K like the work inside it, so count it as debt or a constant or the target drifts.

evidence.text: A nested debt reading at each of up to six plots added about a line of error each, scaled by K (37 lines of target); one reading at the end of the pass fixed it.
About 100 nested hooks in a scroll strip add 2% unless counted as a constant (C_LIB).
The window's own hook time goes to the debt by W_PASS and W_FIX, as K would scale it.
Pattern work is debt, including the window's own 28 MHz overhead.
Broad timer windows counted wrapper work as original producer time and regressed pace.
